Q5100.reason: Prior gun violence made a shooting that injured the next-door neighbor foreseeable, so the owner’s failure to act supports liability; mere knowledge of drug dealing or a blanket no-duty rule is not the ground.

Q5421.reason: Intramuscular ATP alone lasts only about 1–2 seconds of maximal work; the ~10-second figure is the combined ATP–PCr system.

Q8166.reason: Maine’s “hitherto” makes the aphorism a description of past change in progressive societies, but it is commonly misread as a prediction of future development.
